text:
Elliot: Bringing up a new candidate 'sable-2' for semantic vectors in staging. Can we do a quick cohort-fold sanity scan (recall@k, clustering, short-query slice)?
Mira: On it. Will run wiki-holdout 5k queries. Which quant configs to try?
Shawn: Run fp16 baseline + int8 per-channel PTQ + an int4 probe. Compare recall@1/5/10 and silhouette. Use cosine.
Elliot: Enable kvcache, microbatch=8. Keep seed fixed.
Mira: Kickoff command:
```
python eval_runner.py --model sable-2 --dataset wiki-holdout --batch 8 --metrics recall@1,5,10,silhouette --quant fp16
```
Devon: Heads up — our holdout had a bunch of near-duplicates. Add a dedupe by sha1 to avoid inflated recall.
Mira: Good catch, added dedupe filter. Starting fp16 run now. ETA ~8m.
deploy-bot: eval-job started eval-1746665432 on staging-cluster
Mira: FP16 results: recall@1=0.68, recall@5=0.86, recall@10=0.90, silhouette=0.41, clusters=342. Prod-baseline recall@10=0.92.
Elliot: Hmm small drop on recall@10 (0.90 vs 0.92). Any particular slice?
Mira: Short queries (<10 chars) show recall@1 down by ~7%. Long-form queries match or slightly improve.
Shawn: Can you paste the similarity distribution plot?
Mira: Link: https://ci.internal/graphs/1746665432 — positives mean sim drops 0.78 -> 0.72 on short queries.
Mira: INT8 per-channel PTQ run finished: recall@1=0.66, @5=0.84, @10=0.88, silhouette=0.38. INT4 noisy: recall@10=0.82 with big variance.
Devon: So quantization loses ~0.02-0.04 recall but gives ~2.4x cost/throughput improvement. Tradeoff?
Elliot: Try activation clamping + small calibration set (128 batches). Also test hybrid-fp16-first2-layers.
Mira: Kicked int8-calib job with clamp and per-layer scale tuning.
Mira: int8 + calib results: recall@1=0.68, @5=0.86, @10=0.90, silhouette=0.40. Matches fp16 for recall@10.
Elliot: Nice. Runtime perf numbers?
Mira: Median latency/token: fp16 4.5ms, int8-calib 2.1ms. Throughput per-GPU ~2.3x.
Elliot: Proposal: onboard sable-2 int8-calib as canary at 5% traffic. Monitor recall@10 and short-query bucket.
Shawn: Add automatic rollback: revert if recall@10 drops >1.5% vs prod over 30m.
Devon: I'll create rollout config + rollback hooks in Console and add the eval prompts to the watchlist.
Mira: Uploaded artifacts and notebook: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1746665432.zip
Elliot: LGTM, I'll open the PR for canary and add the short-query perturbation tests to the daily eval run. :thumbsup:
Shawn: Also add a small regression alert on silhouette < 0.38 during canary.
Mira: Done. Will follow up with the hybrid layer results if they look better than calib.
